name: East Suffolk Trust Nature Fund (core grants programme)
summary: Core grants of £10,000 and up, for projects of up to five years that restore habitats and species or build community-led nature recovery in Suffolk, with a focus on East Suffolk. Starts with a rolling expression of interest.

geography.label: Suffolk, with a focus on East Suffolk

amount.note: No upper limit; projects of up to five years

reporting: A project update when half the grant is spent and a final report to release the last payment; no set format, usually under two A4 pages.

eligibility.rule: Not-for-profit: has a bank account in the organisation's name
Not-for-profit: has three or more unrelated trustees or directors at different addresses
Project is in East Suffolk or clearly linked to its habitats, species or communities

status.quote: All applicants must first submit an Expression of Interest (EOI), which we accept on a rolling basis.

applicant_types.quote: To be eligible for funding, you or your organisation must be able to demonstrate evidence of work delivering for nature and people, for public benefit. NOT-FOR-PROFITS An organisation is fully eligible if it is a not-for-profit entity with:

geography.quote: East Suffolk Trust can fund work in Suffolk or its immediate surrounding area, with a particular focus on East Suffolk.

access.quote: Full applications are by invite only, with final funding decisions aligned to our quarterly Board of Trustees meetings.

window.quote: All applicants must first submit an Expression of Interest (EOI), which we accept on a rolling basis.

amount.quote: Grants start at £10,000, with no upper limit, and can support projects lasting up to five years.

pool.quote: we are restricted in how much we award by our total annual budget (currently £1.6m per year)

co_finance_required.quote: There is no formal requirement for match or partnership funding.

reporting.quote: in most cases we will require a project update when 50% of the grant has been spent, and a final project report in order to release the final 20% of funds.

effort.quote: All applicants must first submit an Expression of Interest (EOI), which we accept on a rolling basis.
If your EOI is successful, you will be invited to submit a full application.

eligibility.quote: A bank account in the organisation's name
A governing document (e.g., constitution, articles of association, or trust deed)
At least three trustees, directors, or equivalent decision-makers who are not related and do not live at the same address
If your project is based partially or wholly in East Suffolk, or if it has a clear link to habitats, species or communities in East Suffolk, then you are eligible to apply.

after_award.quote: in most cases we will require a project update when 50% of the grant has been spent, and a final project report in order to release the final 20% of funds.
